results.term_definition: Earth is a sphere. To define locations on Earth two sets of imaginary lines are drawn onto the surface of the sphere: Lines of latitude are circles which run around Earth parallel to the equator. The equator has a latitude of 0 degrees. Latitudes in the northern hemisphere are positive; latitudes in the southern hemisphere are negative. The North and South Poles have the highest/lowest latitudes. The North Pole is at +90 degrees and the South Pole at -90 degrees. There are also lines running in great circles through the poles. These are lines of longitude.
